name: Cashonize built-in contracts
description: Protocols the wallet finds out of the box. A bundle a user adds has this same shape, so these double as the worked examples to copy from.

contracts.name: Badgers.cash stake
contracts.description: BCH locked to mint BadgerCoins, released once the lock has aged past its length. Every user's lock sits at one contract address with the owner written into its NFT.

contracts.name: hodl lock
contracts.description: BCH locked until a block height or timestamp. The funding transaction announces the contract's address and locktime but names no owner, so ownership is proved by rebuilding the contract from the wallet's own keys.

contracts.name: TapSwap listing
contracts.description: An asset listed for sale, held by a per-listing contract at output 0 of the listing transaction and live for as long as that output stays unspent. The announcement names the maker, so no contract has to be rebuilt to know whose it is. Cancelling returns the asset at any time, so it is owned rather than locked.

contracts.name: Cauldron liquidity pool
contracts.description: BCH and a fungible token provided as liquidity. The contract takes its owner as its only parameter, so all pools of one owner sit at the one address built from that owner's key hash, and each fungible-token coin there is a pool.

contracts.name: Guanaco pool (0.01% fee)
contracts.description: BCH and a fungible token provided as liquidity on Guanaco, a Cauldron-derived pool that adds a fee tier and a protocol fee output. Each fee tier is a different contract with its own address, so each has its own manifest; this one charges 0.01%.

contracts.name: Guanaco pool (0.05% fee)
contracts.description: BCH and a fungible token provided as liquidity on Guanaco, a Cauldron-derived pool that adds a fee tier and a protocol fee output. Each fee tier is a different contract with its own address, so each has its own manifest; this one charges 0.05%.

contracts.name: Guanaco pool (0.3% fee)
contracts.description: BCH and a fungible token provided as liquidity on Guanaco, a Cauldron-derived pool that adds a fee tier and a protocol fee output. Each fee tier is a different contract with its own address, so each has its own manifest; this one charges 0.3%.

contracts.name: Guanaco pool (1% fee)
contracts.description: BCH and a fungible token provided as liquidity on Guanaco, a Cauldron-derived pool that adds a fee tier and a protocol fee output. Each fee tier is a different contract with its own address, so each has its own manifest; this one charges 1%.

contracts.name: ParyonUSD loan
contracts.description: BCH collateral against PUSD debt. Every loan mints its own category, whose registry declares the paryonusd extension that fetches the loan's state from its contract before the key is parsed. Only the owner key, the minting NFT, controls the loan; a management key does not.

contracts.name: ParyonUSD staking receipt
contracts.description: PUSD staked at an epoch. The receipt records the amount staked, and the live stake can have been reduced since, so its value is an estimate.
